import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    l = len(s)
    c = 0
    i = 0
    while i < l - 1:
        j = i
        while j < l - 1 and s[i] == s[j + 1]:
            j += 1
        z = j - i + 1
        if z % 2 == 0:
            c += 1
        i = j + 1
    print(c)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
